name: designersmeet-crm
description: Custom CRM for DesignersMeet — Shopify orders, freelancer database, queue-driven workflows, social pipeline.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @dm/backend" "npm run dev -w @dm/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @dm/shared && npm run build -w @dm/backend && npm run build -w @dm/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @dm/shared && npm run typecheck -w @dm/backend && npm run typecheck -w @dm/frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @dm/backend && npm run lint -w @dm/frontend
